finding.description: The first Armor runtime carried _armor_context inside ActionIntent.parameters. Existing Third Wish brokers intentionally reject undeclared parameter keys, so a strict broker would reject the otherwise valid armored request before its own real operation contract could run.

mechanism: Armor evaluates the original intent containing structured _armor_context.
Armor context is then removed using an immutable ActionIntent replacement before adapter preflight.
The registered effect handler also receives the sanitized intent rather than Armor control-plane metadata.
The original intent remains unchanged for Third Wish request identity and audit hashing.

broker_composition_observation.active_network: v18.7.45 exposes register(fabric) and installs WEB.HTTP.POST / NETWORK.CONNECT / NETWORK.LISTEN_LOCAL / API.CALL through fabric.register_handler(..., preflight=self.preflight).
broker_composition_observation.host_broker: v18.7.41 exposes register(fabric) and installs WEB.HTTP.GET / DNS.RESOLVE / FILESYSTEM / PROCESS capabilities through fabric.register_handler(..., preflight=self.preflight).
broker_composition_observation.identity_effects: v18.7.44 exposes register(fabric) against ThirdWishCapabilityFabric and therefore can accept the armored subclass, subject to its own bound reauthorization requirements.

claim_ceiling: The hardened reference fabric is compatible with strict parameter allowlists in the tested composition pattern. This still does not establish that every external-effect path in the entire repository is routed through ArmoredThirdWishCapabilityFabric.
